references.text: Describes how the inheritance was distributed to the nine and a half tribes on the west side of the Jordan, as a direct fulfillment of the command in 13:7
The continuation of the land distribution to the remaining tribes who had not yet received their inheritance
The background for why only nine and a half tribes were to receive land west of the Jordan—the half-tribe of Manasseh received land on the east side together with Reuben and Gad
Moses' command that the nine and a half tribes should inherit the land of Canaan, which Joshua is now to carry out
Moses explains how the half-tribe of Manasseh received their land east of the Jordan, explaining why only half the tribe is mentioned here
The Lord's promise to Joshua that he will distribute the land as an inheritance to the people, which is now to be fulfilled
